description: Frozen provenance manifest for every evaluated model + agent-harness bundle. Each bundle was run under three policy levels (control; non-root; NIST-derived high = the high-nist preset), at reasoning effort high, with three trials per cell.

policy_detail.non-root: Non-root user with a locked root account; no network or filesystem gates.
policy_detail.high-nist: NIST-derived High tier: the high-nist preset (N5 fixed-trusted egress wall + F2 read-only rootfs + P2 privilege lockdown). This is the high tier; it resolves to the N5/F2/P2 point in the axis model.

inference_route.model_plane: OpenRouter, reached through the in-sandbox loopback accounting proxy (single route for every harness).

bundles.note: Anthropic's declared default vendor fallback for Claude Fable 5 is Claude Opus 4.8; the fallback is kept as configured, so requests that fall back are served by anthropic/claude-opus-4.8.

Version exception. Every other Claude Code bundle is pinned to 2.1.206. Claude Code 2.1.206 did not expose a correct anthropic/claude-opus-5 model identifier until 2.1.219; 2.1.220 (the next patch release) supplied it, so Opus 5 alone was evaluated on 2.1.220. Recorded here in the frozen experiment provenance.

ablation_crossings.crossing: A model normally run under Codex, evaluated instead under the Grok Build harness, to isolate the harness contribution from the model.
A model normally run under the Grok Build harness, evaluated instead under Codex, completing the 2x2 harness-vs-model ablation with GPT-5.6 Luna.

provenance_sources: Harness version pins in this repository: src/boundarybench/harness/claude_code.py (2.1.206), codex.py (rust-v0.142.5), grok.py (0.2.87), terminus_2.py (harbor 0.13.1 / terminus 2.0.0).
The reasoning-effort default (high) is enforced by every harness adapter (default_effort_level == 'high'), covered by tests/test_harness_adapter.py.
The high-nist preset definition is in src/boundarybench/daytona/policy_axes.py (resolved via src/boundarybench/terminalbench/policies.py).
Provider model IDs, per-bundle harness assignment, the Opus 5 version exception, and the Claude Fable 5 -> Claude Opus 4.8 vendor fallback are taken from the frozen campaign / runner registry.
provenance_notes: Reasoning effort is high for every bundle and crossing (the evaluated configuration; the repository enforces high as every harness's test-locked default). The pre-standardization pareto campaign specifications in the runner registry recorded effort 'max' for the Claude Code bundles and the harness default for the Terminus-2 bundles; effort was standardized to high across all harnesses before the evaluated runs. See BUNDLES.md.

The two ablation crossings are defined by the roster; their provider model IDs and harness versions are verified from the sources above, but a dedicated campaign specification for the two crossings was not present in the registry file consulted (which enumerates the twelve pareto bundles).
Claude Fable 5's fallback constant (anthropic/claude-opus-4.8) is defined in the frozen runner registry, not in this repository's carved-down harness code.
